texts.name: Hollowmere
texts.blurb: A mere in a hollow that the trees lean over.

raw.name: The wood walks
raw.blurb: Every 116 seconds roots close 3 ways and open 3 others. A green glow marks the ways that are open.

people.name: The Moss-Abbess
greet: Careful, climber. The wood walks. Two wisps are bound in it, and the Thorn Mother waits at its heart, far to the north. Free the wisps, cut the roots that feed it, and its door opens.

people.name: The Path-Lighter
greet: Two lamps, a lost tool, and nobody with the legs for it. Except you.

people.name: The Kiln-Mother
greet: You found the charcoal clearing? Then you can stand by it a while.

people.name: The Amber-Seller
greet: Shards for what you need. The wood takes nothing back, so I take shards.

quests.name: The Bound Wisps
intro: Clear the bramble, and its wisp follows you: lead it to the heart. Then the standing stones: the Stag-Crowned guards the second wisp. Last, cut the three roots that feed the Thorn Mother, and its door opens.
outro: The wisps are home, the roots are cut. The Thorn Mother’s door stands open, far in the north. Rest first, then go in.

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the bramble to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the standing stones to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Cut the three roots that feed the heart
Go to the Thorn Mother’s door

quests.name: The Pale Stag
intro: The Pale Stag walks round the hollow oak. Fell it and the wood grows calmer.
outro: A relic from the old wood. Keep it.

quests.name: Mossjaw
intro: Mossjaw walks the far glades. Nobody lights the lamps while it does.

quests.name: The Spore Lamps
intro: Two spore lamps: one at the wayside shrine, one at the mossy spring. Light both, stand by each a moment, and I can see the paths move.
outro: Now I can see. Take this, it was in the moss.

quests.name: The Lost Spade
intro: Ivy dropped a spade in the bark den and will not go back for it. Carry it to the camp fire. A hit and you drop it.

steps.text: Bring the spade from the bark den to the fire

quests.name: The Burners’ Watch
intro: My stacks lie past the charcoal clearing. Find them, then hold the clearing while I bring the charcoal in: the hounds smell the smoke.
outro: All in, and dry. Take this.

steps.text: Hold the clearing while the charcoal comes in

doors.name: The Thorn Mother’s door
doors.locked: Roots hold the door shut. The Moss-Abbess has a quest about the wisps.

doors.name: The gate up
doors.locked: The gate is sealed. Its warden answers only once the Thorn Mother has fallen.

lines: Another climber. I am Mabel. Walk into the thicket behind me and we see who is better. Win, and I fight beside you.

lore.name: The root stone
text: The charcoal burners left their fires burning.
The wood grew round the fires and kept them.

hound.name: Bark hound
hound.blurb: Fast, and hunts in a pack.

named1.name: The Pale Stag
named1.blurb: Walks round the old oak and strikes hard.

named2.name: Mossjaw
named2.blurb: Walks the far glades and strikes hard.

root.name: Feeding root
root.blurb: A root that feeds the heart. It cannot move; it throws thorns.

ruler.name: The Thorn Mother
ruler.title: She grows the walls
ruler.line: Cut the roots that feed it; it stands open when none is left
